invariants.rationale: The method returns a Pair and should not return null as per typical API contract.

The method receives a list of FileSlice objects as an argument, should not be null.
The first element (Stream<HoodieClusteringGroup>) in the returned Pair should not be null for valid clustering plan operation.
The second element (Boolean) in the returned Pair should not be null.
